title: Clarify agent_metadata.feature optionally-tag vs MUST policy wording
description: SD soft nit on #264: agent_metadata.feature still says optionally tag (CLI capability) while CONTRIBUTING_AGENT policy says MUST for AI agents — clarify feature language so capability vs doctrine is not confused.

comments.text: Verified on develop: features/agent/agent_metadata.feature describes optional CLI capability, while CONTRIBUTING_AGENT.md separately mandates provenance for AI-agent usage. The policy distinction is already clear. Closing as completed.
